name: Philia Elpis
source:
Cheerful Knight.

Knight belonging to the guild Abestaag. Bright and cheerful character who tries to protect the smiles of people. Sometimes shows signs of something sad having happened in the past. Often works with the Caro family’s guild Sucseed and although not belonging directly to Caro family is still considered to be part of it. Moves to Mereshias branch office of abestaag to follow the others.

Graduate from adventurer training school Voromia Academy situated in Felshis.
